title: Malicious code in service-roles-registry (npm)
description: The npm package service-roles-registry version 99.0.2 contains malicious code that executes a preinstall script. This script collects host identifiers such as hostname, user info, current working directory, and package metadata, then sends this data to a hardcoded external endpoint without user consent. The package appears to be a dependency confusion lure designed to override an internal package of the same name.
